artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic numerical check of the fixed-matrix ceiling, two-dimensional robust envelope, radical thresholds, and a transient-amplification example.
Deterministic output of the numerical verification.

limitations: Real SPD systems and simultaneous weighted Jacobi only. The exact condition-number minimax envelope is two-dimensional. The metric is Euclidean one-step error norm, not an energy norm, residual norm, or floating-point performance measure. Historical full-text access was incomplete for two older sources.
provenance: Euclidean one-step nonexpansiveness is reduced to a symmetric matrix ceiling, then optimized exactly over two-dimensional SPD matrices at fixed condition number.
record_title: Sharp Euclidean damping frontier for weighted Jacobi on 2×2 SPD systems
